```{r}
 # Libraries
source("./RSCobra.R")
```

```{r}
X2 = read.csv('data/lung500.csv', head = FALSE)
X2 = scale(data.matrix(X2))

```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
l = rscobra(
  X2,
  lambda = 0.001,
  k_col = 5,
  nu = 0.5,
  gamma = 1000,
  tmax = 100,
  phi = 0.5,
  recalculate_weights = TRUE,
  tol = 1e-7,
  adaptive_nu = FALSE
)

set.seed(1)
l2 = rscobra(
  X2,
  lambda = 0.001,
  k_col = 5,
  nu = 0.5,
  gamma = 1000,
  tmax = 100,
  phi = 0.5,
  recalculate_weights = TRUE,
  tol = 1e-7,
  adaptive_nu = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
checker <- gen_checkerboard(100, 200, 5, 10, 300, 1)
rs_checker <- tune_rscobra(checker$X,
                           lambdas=c(0.01, 0.1),
                           gammas=c(1000, 2000),
                           percent_noise=0.3)

best_checker_index <- which(rs_checker$cv_data$eBIC == min(rs_checker$cv_data$eBIC))
best_checker_run <- rs_checker$all_runs[[best_checker_index]]
plot(sort(best_checker_run$w))
plot_matrix(mat_df(best_checker_run, filter_weight=1/500))
```

```{r}
X2 = read.csv('data/lung100.csv', head = FALSE)
X2 = scale(data.matrix(X2))

cv_100 <- tune_rscobra(X2, k_cols=c(3, 5), k_rows=c(3, 5),
                       nus=c(0.1),
                       lambdas=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1),
                       gammas=c(10, 100, 1000), tols = c(1e-6))

best_lung100_index <- which(cv_100$cv_data$eBIC == min(cv_100$cv_data$eBIC))
best_lung100_run <- cv_100$all_runs[[best_lung100_index]]
plot(sort(best_lung100_run$w))
plot_matrix(mat_df(best_lung100_run, filter_weight=0))
```

```{r}
lym <- t(read.csv("./data/lymphoma.x.txt", header=FALSE, sep=" "))
lym <- scale(lym)


cv_lym <- tune_rscobra(lym,
                       lambdas=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1),
                       nus=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1),
                       gammas=c(10, 100, 1000),
                       k_cols = c(5),
                       k_rows = c(5))

# Need to increase gamma to avoid perfect
best_lym_index <- which(cv_lym$cv_data$eBIC == min(cv_lym$cv_data$eBIC))
best_lym_run <- cv_lym$all_runs[[best_lym_index]]
plot(sort(best_lym_run$w))
plot_matrix(mat_df(best_lym_run, filter_weight=1/4026))

plot_matrix(mat_df(cv_lym$all_runs[[25]], filter_weight=1/4000))


plot_matrix(
  mat_df(best_lym_run, filter_weight = 1/4000) |>
    mutate(value =
             case_when(value < -2 ~ -2,
                       value > 2 ~ 2,
                       TRUE ~ value)),
  bin_scale = 10,
  alpha_weight = TRUE
)

plot_matrix(
  mat_df(best_lym_run, filter_weight = 1/4000) |>
    mutate(value = value / sd(value)),
  bin_scale = 10
)
```

```{r}
srbct <- t(read.csv("./data/srbct.x.txt", header=FALSE, sep=" "))
srbct <- scale(srbct)


cv_srbct <- tune_rscobra(srbct, lambdas=c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1), nus=c(0.1), gammas=c(10, 100, 1000), parallel=TRUE,
                         recalculate_weights = FALSE, k_cols = c(12), k_rows=c(4))

best_srbct_index <- which(cv_srbct$cv_data$eBIC == min(cv_srbct$cv_data$eBIC))
best_srbct_run <- cv_srbct$all_runs[[best_srbct_index]]
plot(sort(best_srbct_run$w))
plot_matrix(mat_df(best_srbct_run, filter_weight=1/2000))

plot_matrix(
  mat_df(best_srbct_run, filter_weight = 1/2000) |>
    mutate(value =
             case_when(value < -2 ~ -2,
                       value > 2 ~ 2,
                       TRUE ~ value)),
  bin_scale = 10,
  alpha_weight = TRUE
)

plot_matrix(
  mat_df(best_srbct_run, filter_weight = 1/2000) |>
    mutate(value = value / sd(value)),
  bin_scale = 10
)
```
